_README.what: Owner-labeled example fixtures for the v1.5 trigger acceptance test.
_README.origin: Each fixture reproduces the essential OHLC geometry of a labeled chart image from the strategy conversation (owner-confirmed labels). Values are synthetic but geometrically faithful: break distances, body sizes, wick relationships match what the owner confirmed.
_README.usage: Run the trigger on the LAST two candles (prev,new); the context candle exists only where noted. Assert expected_alert and expected_note. ex06 is deliberately 1-pip marginal to lock the exact-OHLC lesson.
_README.labels_authority: owner corrections override: ex03 = NO ALERT per owner correction (original pixel misread).
